decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already records WROOM-1 as the selected module variant; the GPIO reassignments do not otherwise change module selection.
The existing same-message MODIFY already changes the boost enable GPIO and the GPIO-dependent standby policy from GPIO3 to GPIO5.
The existing same-message MODIFY already updates the LED standby-power control to use 5V_EN on GPIO5; the LED data GPIO and other interface attributes remain unchanged.
Reassigning ESP32 GPIOs does not change the DCDC1 rail voltage, current rating, or load coverage.
The GPIO changes do not alter the standalone USB supply, source-selection behavior, activation condition, or powered 3.3V rail.
The sensor board's role as a connector fanout remains valid and contains no affected GPIO assignment.
The source changes 5V_EN, SCL0, and SPI MOSI assignments, not the charge-status GPIO13 or external charge-LED circuit.
The GPIO reassignment does not change the battery protection controller, cutoff thresholds, or protection components.
The NTC connector and AXP2101 thermal-protection behavior are independent of the reassigned ESP32 GPIOs.
The source does not alter the battery voltage range, AXP2101 power-source role, or system-load coverage.
Changing controller GPIO assignments does not change the number, separation, or identity of the project boards.
The connector pinout carries named signals such as SCL0 and 5V_EN but does not encode their ESP32 GPIO numbers, so the interface remains valid unchanged.
